$description: Klang design tokens (W3C Design Tokens format). Source of truth for the app's colours: run scripts/gen_tokens.py to regenerate Color.kt and design/tokens.css. Do not edit those by hand.

seed.$description: Seed colours of the Material 3 scheme. Tone 40 is used in light theme, tone 80 in dark theme. Other roles (surface, error, ...) are Material 3 defaults, or follow the wallpaper on Android 12+.

data.$description: Data colours: baseline vs treatment, chosen to stay distinguishable for common colour-vision deficiencies. Fixed, never follow the wallpaper.
